work.title: Define the open-Work persistence contract
work.description: Document and encode the new invariants before modifying Git operations. Core invariants: an open Work is authoritative only on its manifest ref; a Change branch contains candidate product code, not mutable orchestration state; starting a stage does not move the base branch; attaching or recreating a worktree does not move the base branch; accept creates one squash commit; rollback, cancel, and supersede create no base commit; archive refs preserve candidate code when candidate code exists; legacy manifest projections remain readable during the compatibility period. Recovery rules are defined for interrupted branch materialization.
acceptance: The persistence contract is documented in docs/architecture.md
Each invariant has an automated test placeholder or implementation
The contract distinguishes authority, projection, cache, and archive
Recovery rules are defined for interrupted branch materialization
